mapper.sql: (n.type='BROADCAST' OR r.user_id IS NOT NULL) AND COALESCE(r.deleted,0)=0 AND (n.expire_at IS NULL OR n.expire_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
FROM paiflow_notification n LEFT JOIN paiflow_notification_recipient r ON r.notification_id=n.id AND r.user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT n.id,n.type,n.title,n.body,n.template_code AS templateCode,n.payload_json AS payload,n.meta_json AS meta, n.creator_user_id AS creatorUserId,n.create_time AS createdAt,n.expire_at AS expireAt, COALESCE(r.is_read,0) AS isRead,r.read_at AS readAt,r.received_at AS receivedAt WHERE ORDER BY n.create_time DESC,n.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT n.id WHERE AND COALESCE(r.is_read,0)=0 ORDER BY n.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO paiflow_notification_recipient(notification_id,user_id,is_read,deleted,read_at,received_at) SELECT n.id,#{userId},1,0,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE AND n.id IN #{id} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_read=1,read_at=COALESCE(read_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))

INSERT INTO paiflow_notification_recipient(notification_id,user_id,is_read,deleted,read_at,received_at) SELECT n.id,#{userId},COALESCE(r.is_read,0),1,r.read_at,COALESCE(r.received_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE n.id=#{id} AND ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deleted=1
